lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are organized into approximately four horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with an increasing spatial gap between centroids in the more posterior clusters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a visible grid-like pattern of 'nodes' on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a high-luminance superior edge and a shadowed inferior edge, extending from the post-branchial region toward the posterior frame edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A circular reddish-brown lesion or pigment anomaly is located on the mid-flank, immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a dense, high-frequency distribution of smaller, high-intensity white spots relative to the larger spots on the primary flank.
